summary: Tested User Permissions Management System. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified: Permissions column in User Management, PermissionsManager page with all 10 permissions, toggle switches, Select All/Deselect All functionality, Dashboard as required permission, and Save Changes button activation.

backend_api_tests.details: All 13 pytest tests passed: GET /api/auth/permissions/all returns 10 permissions, GET/PUT /api/auth/users/{id}/permissions work correctly, authentication and authorization checks in place

permissions_column_in_user_management.details: User Management page shows 'Permissions' column header with green badges showing first 4 permissions (dashboard, hr, financial, invoices) and '+6' indicator for remaining permissions

key_icon_for_permissions.details: Key icon button in Actions column navigates to /permissions/:userId route

permissions_manager_page.details: Page loads with user info card (name, email, role badge), Available Permissions grid showing all 10 permissions with toggle switches

all_10_permissions_displayed.details: Dashboard, Human Resources, Financial, Invoices, Purchases, Projects, Analytics, Settings, User Management, Approvals - all displayed with icons and toggle switches

dashboard_required_permission.details: Dashboard permission shows 'Required permission' label and cannot be disabled (remains ON even after Deselect All)

select_deselect_all_buttons.details: Select All enables all 10 permissions, Deselect All keeps only Dashboard (1 of 10) as required

save_changes_button.details: Button is disabled when no changes, becomes active (green gradient) when permissions are modified

permissions_summary.details: Shows 'X of 10 permissions enabled' with 'X Enabled' (green) and 'Y Disabled' (red) badges

green_red_color_coding.details: Enabled permissions show green background and green toggle, disabled permissions show red background and red toggle

role_based_access_control.details: Frontend redirects non-admin users to dashboard, Backend returns 403 for non-admin role attempting to modify permissions

context_for_next_testing_agent: User Permissions Management System fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs: GET /api/auth/permissions/all returns all 10 permissions, GET /api/auth/users/{id}/permissions returns user's current permissions, PUT /api/auth/users/{id}/permissions updates permissions (admin only). Frontend: PermissionsManager.jsx component at /permissions/:userId route, UserManagement.jsx shows Permissions column with badges. Admin roles: General Manager, CEO, Board Chairman (and Arabic equivalents) can manage permissions.
